DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行のカードをなくしました。使われないようにする手続きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カード紛失の相談を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have lost my bank card. I would like advice on the procedure to prevent it from being used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help with a lost card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後にカードを使ったのは、いつ、どちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and where did you last use the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の昼、この支店のATMです。夕方に店で財布を出しましたが、その時はカードを使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後のカード使用を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday at noon, at this branch's ATM. I took my wallet out at a shop in the evening, but I did not use the card then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you last used the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カードの最終使用は昼のATMで、財布を確認したのが夕方の店ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the last card use was at the ATM at noon, and you checked your wallet at the shop in the evening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。店で使ったと言ってしまいそうでした。カードが財布にあったかは、その時見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布を見た場所と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I almost said I used it at the shop. I did not check then whether the card was in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish this from the place where you checked your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の確認をして、利用停止の手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will verify your identity and explain the procedure for suspending use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。まず停止を相談し、再発行は必要なものを聞いてから進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用停止の手続きへ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I would like to discuss stopping the card first, and proceed with reissuing it after asking what is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Proceed to the procedure for suspending use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人確認の書類を拝見した後、担当者から停止と再発行の手順をそれぞれ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After looking at your identification documents, the person in charge will explain the suspension and reissue procedures separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類はこちらです。停止が終わったか確認してから、再発行に必要な持ち物や費用を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再発行の前に必要な確認を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here are my documents. I will check that the suspension is complete before asking what to bring and what fees are required for reissuing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask what needs to be checked before reissuing the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。現在の手続き状況を担当者と確認し、一つずつご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will check the current status of the procedures with the person in charge and guide you through them one by one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご購入の商品についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about an item you purchased, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。砂糖を買うつもりで、この塩を買ってしまいました。レシートはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入した商品とレシートを見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I meant to buy sugar but bought this salt instead. Here is the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the purchased item and receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品の不具合ではなく、お買い間違いなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So this is a mistaken purchase, rather than a fault with the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。家で商品名を読んで気付きました。袋はまだ開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の買い間違いだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I noticed when I read the product name at home. I haven't opened the bag yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you bought the wrong item yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 交換できるか、商品の状態と店の条件を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the product's condition and our store's conditions to see whether it can be exchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。未開封なら必ず交換できると決めず、まず条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封であることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I would like to hear the conditions first, rather than assume an unopened item can always be exchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it is unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お預かりして確認します。交換が可能な場合は、差額などもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will take it and check. If an exchange is possible, we will also explain any price difference and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分で売り場の砂糖と入れ替えず、この商品を受付に出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換の可否を担当に確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will hand this item in at the counter, instead of swapping it myself for sugar from the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the person in charge to check whether an exchange is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらで担当の確認をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Please wait here while the person in charge checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、商品とレシートをお渡しします。買い間違いの相談として、結果を聞いてから対応を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前に別の商品と取り替えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will hand over the item and receipt. I will treat this as a request about a mistaken purchase and decide what to do after hearing the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not swap it for another item before the check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。未開封の状態と購入記録を確認し、交換の可否をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check that it is unopened and verify the purchase record, then explain whether an exchange is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 絵を描かれるのですね。どの辺りで座る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are going to sketch, correct? Where are you planning to sit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 橋が見えるので、この入口に小さな椅子を置きたいです。ここで描いても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写生したい場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can see the bridge from here, so I would like to put a small chair at this entrance. Is it all right to draw here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where you would like to sketch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 椅子と道具を置くと、橋へ出入りする通路が狭くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Putting a chair and your equipment there would narrow the passage used to enter and leave the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 人が通る度に道具をよけることになるんですね。通路をふさがずに橋が見える場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 椅子を置けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I would have to move my equipment every time someone passes. Is there somewhere I can see the bridge without blocking the passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can put a chair there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広場の端のベンチからも、橋を斜めに見られます。ベンチの利用は他の方と譲り合ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also see the bridge at an angle from the bench at the edge of the square. Please share the bench considerately with others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 正面の構図にはこだわらず、そちらへ行きます。追加の椅子は出さなくても描けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正面の構図にこだわらず広場のベンチへ移り、追加の椅子を出さずに描けそうだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will go there without insisting on a front-on composition. It looks as though I can draw without putting out an extra chair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will move to the bench in the plaza rather than insist on a front-on composition, and that you should be able to draw without putting out an extra chair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。地面に道具を広げる場合も、歩く場所は空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Even if you spread equipment on the ground, please leave the walking area clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かばんの中から使う物だけ出して、足元の内側にまとめます。橋の入口には何も置きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使う道具だけを足元の内側にまとめ、橋の入口には何も置かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take only what I need out of my bag and keep it together close to my feet, on my side. I won't put anything at the bridge entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will keep only the tools you need close by, on the inner side of your feet, and will not put anything at the bridge entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ベンチはこの道を進んだ広場の端です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. The bench is at the edge of the square further along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道具をしまってから移動します。空いている席を確かめ、通路を空けて写生を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具をまとめて移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pack my equipment before moving. I will check for a free seat and start sketching with the passage kept clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pack your equipment and move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。広場へ向かう途中も、橋を渡る方の通行を妨げないようお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. On your way to the square as well, please take care not to obstruct people crossing the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまでの切符をお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where would you like a ticket to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の観光駅まで往復でお願いします。帰るのは明日の午後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復の行き先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: A return ticket to the next tourist station, please. I will be coming back tomorrow afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your destination for the return journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの往復商品は当日のみ有効です。明日の帰りには使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This return-ticket product is valid only on the same day. You cannot use it for tomorrow's return journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 往復なら翌日も使えると思っていました。今、行きと帰りを別々に買う方法もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りが翌日だと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought a return ticket could also be used the next day. Is there a way to buy the outward and return journeys separately now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Add that your return is the next day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通常の片道券をそれぞれ購入する方法があります。利用日を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can purchase a regular single ticket for each journey. We will check their travel dates separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実は明日の帰る時刻が決まっていません。帰りだけ現地で買っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 候補の券の有効日を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Actually, I haven't decided what time I will return tomorrow. Can I buy just the return ticket there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the valid dates of the ticket under consideration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現地の発売方法を案内で確認しましょう。こちらでは、今の行きの券だけ購入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the information on how tickets are sold there. You can buy just the ticket for your outward journey now here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りの購入場所を先に確認して、今日は行きだけにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰りの予定が変わる可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to check where to buy the return ticket first, and buy only the outward ticket today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your return plans may change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現地には通常の片道券の券売機があると、案内に載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The information says there is a ticket machine there for regular single tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は行きの片道券を一枚お願いします。当日限定の往復商品は選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件を聞いてから券を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. One single ticket for the outward journey today, please. I won't choose the same-day-only return product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a ticket after hearing its conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、本日分の片道券をご用意します。帰りは明日、現地の案内で行き先を確認してお求めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will prepare a single ticket for today. For your return tomorrow, please check the destination in the local information before buying your ticket there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた通知についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about the notice you received, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二十日と二十五日が書いてあります。二十五日に説明会へ行けば、回答もその日に出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の二つの日付を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It gives the 20th and the 25th. If I attend the briefing on the 25th, can I submit my response that day too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the two dates on the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二十日の横には「回答期限」、二十五日の横には「説明会」とありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It says “response deadline” next to the 20th and “briefing” next to the 25th.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十日までに回答が必要で、説明会当日に出すのでは遅い可能性があるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: どちらが返送期限か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So a response is required by the 20th, and submitting it on the briefing day could be too late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which date is the deadline for returning it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 具体的な提出方法は、この通知を出した担当課でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The department that issued this notice will explain the specific submission method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 回答欄をまだ書いていません。郵送するのか、窓口へ持つのか、担当の方に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明会前に回答が必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't filled in the response section yet. I would like to ask the person in charge whether to mail it or bring it to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that a response is needed before the briefing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの担当課です。通知の右上に問い合わせ番号もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the department in charge. There is also an inquiry reference number at the top right of the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号も伝えると、同じ通知の話だと分かりますね。紙を持って直接相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回答方法を担当へ確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I give that number too, they will know which notice I mean. I will bring the paper and ask them directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the response method with the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。二十日が消印の期限か到着の期限かも、担当に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also ask whether the 20th is the postmark deadline or the arrival deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこまで確かめます。二十五日の説明会と混ぜず、回答期限と提出方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当窓口に通知を持って進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check that too. I will ask about the response deadline and submission method without confusing them with the briefing on the 25th.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the notice and go to the responsible counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。この廊下の奥に担当窓口があります。通知をお持ちになってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The counter in charge is at the end of this corridor. Please take your notice with you and go there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 当院は初めてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit to our hospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この科は初めてですが、病院には一年前に眼科で来たことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めてなのは診療科だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my first time in this department, but I came to this hospital's ophthalmology department a year ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only the department is new to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の診察券はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your previous patient card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、これです。科が違うので、新しい患者番号になると思い、初診の用紙を取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 以前の受診歴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. Since this is a different department, I thought I would get a new patient number, so I took a first-visit form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your previous visit history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、この番号の登録を確認します。科が初めてでも、病院の受診歴は分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: First we will check the registration under this number. Even if this is your first time in the department, we ask separately about your hospital visit history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。「病院は初めて」とは書かず、以前の眼科受診も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 「病院は初めて」とは書かず、以前の眼科受診も伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not write “first visit to the hospital,” and will also mention my previous ophthalmology visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you will not write that this is your first visit to the hospital, and will also mention your previous visit to the eye clinic. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 登録が見つかりました。今回はこの診察券で、こちらの科の受付へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We found your registration. This time we will direct you to this department's reception using this patient card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい番号を自分で作る用紙ではなく、今の番号を使うんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい番号を作る必要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I will use my current number, rather than a form for creating a new number myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether a new number needs to be created. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらの問診票に記入してください。今回の受診区分も窓口で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please fill in this medical questionnaire. We will also check the classification for this visit at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この診察券と問診票を提出します。初めての科ということと、一年前の受診歴は両方伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内された受付区分で手続きする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will submit this patient card and questionnaire. I will explain both that this department is new to me and that I visited a year ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Follow the reception classification you were directed to. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。同じ番号の記録を確認しながら、本日の受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will proceed with today's registration while checking the records under the same number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った物についてのご相談ですね。お品物をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about something found, correct? Do you have the item with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。公園のベンチに袋がありました。拾得物の場所を聞かれたので、この交番の住所を書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋を持参しておらず相談先の住所を書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. There was a bag on a park bench. When I was asked where the found item was, I wrote the address of this police box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not bring the bag and wrote the address of the place where you came for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは相談に来られた場所ですね。袋を実際に見つけた所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is where you came for advice. Let's check where you actually found the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 南の入口から二つ目のベンチです。私は袋を運んでおらず、そこに置いたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際に見たベンチと置いたままの状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was on the second bench from the south entrance. I have not moved the bag; I left it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the bench where you actually saw it and say you left it there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在この交番でお預かりしている物としては記録できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot record it as an item currently being held at this police box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が届けたことにならないよう、場所の欄を直したいです。見たのは午後一時ごろです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発見時刻を示し届出場所の記入を訂正したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to correct the location field so it does not look as though I handed it in. I saw it at about 1 p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the discovery time and ask to correct the reported location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その時刻と、まだ持参していない状況を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask separately about that time and the fact that you have not brought it here yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今も同じ場所にあるかは分かりません。さっき見たという情報だけをお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の所在は未確認で過去に見た情報だと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't know whether it is still in the same place now. I am only giving you the information that I saw it earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the unconfirmed current location from information about an earlier sighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。場所が分かる案内や写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Do you have a map or photograph that shows the location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 公園の案内図でベンチを示せます。自分で戻る前に、今後どうするか伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内図で場所を示し戻る前に次の対応を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can point out the bench on the park map. Before going back there myself, I would like to ask what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the location on the map and ask what to do next before returning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内図で位置を確認し、現物をお預かりしていない相談として担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will confirm the location on the map and pass this to the person in charge as a consultation about an item we have not physically received.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居届のことでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about your mail-forwarding change-of-address notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。届は先週出しました。転送開始は明日と案内されましたが、会社が三日前に書類を送ったそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居届の受付状況を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I submitted it last week. I was told forwarding would start tomorrow, but my company says it sent documents three days ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the acceptance status of your change-of-address notification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その書類は旧住所宛てに送られたのですね。追跡番号などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those documents were addressed to your old address, correct? Do you have a tracking number or anything similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旧住所です。普通郵便と聞いたので、番号はありません。発送日のメモだけあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始予定より前の郵便が心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the old address. I was told it was ordinary mail, so there is no number. I only have a note of the dispatch date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are concerned about mail sent before the scheduled start date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個々の配達状況は、その情報だけではここで確定できません。届の受付状況とあわせて担当へ相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot establish the delivery status of an individual item here from that information alone. Let's consult the person in charge, along with checking your notification's acceptance status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。開始前に送られた分も、必ず新住所へ届くとは今は言い切れないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転送開始前に発送された郵便も必ず新住所へ届くとは、現時点では断言できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. So at this point you cannot say for certain that items sent before forwarding starts will also arrive at the new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that, at this point, it is not possible to guarantee that mail sent before forwarding begins will also reach your new address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場では言い切れません。差出人にも、返送の有無などを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We cannot say for certain here. Please also ask the sender whether the item has been returned and about other relevant details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社に発送日と宛先を確かめます。もう一枚転居届を書けば早くなる、ということではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人にも確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the dispatch date and destination with my company. Filling in another change-of-address notification would not make it faster, would it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to check with the sender as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず、すでに出した届を確認します。重複して出す前に担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: First we will check the notification you have already submitted. Please consult the person in charge before submitting a duplicate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付の控えと発送日のメモを見せます。届を出し直さず、今の登録と書類の件を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存の届を重複して出さず担当に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the acknowledgment copy and my note of the dispatch date. I will discuss the current registration and the documents without submitting the notification again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult the person in charge without duplicating the existing notification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当者へ引き継ぎますので、この控えをお持ちのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will refer you to the person in charge. Please keep that copy with you while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録住所の変更をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your registered address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し違います。一か月だけ姉の家に滞在するので、その間の郵便の送り先を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一時滞在であることを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not exactly. I will stay at my older sister's home for just one month, and I would like advice on where my mail should be sent during that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that this is a temporary stay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お住まいの住所自体は変わっていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So your residential address itself has not changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。元の家へ戻ります。住所変更の用紙に姉の住所を書いてしまう前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正式な住所変更ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I will return to my original home. I would like to check before writing my sister's address on an address-change form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that this is not a formal change of address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵送先だけを別に指定できるか、対象の郵便と口座の状態を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the mail concerned and your account status to see whether a separate mailing address can be specified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎月届く案内のことです。一か月だけで、カードなどを再発行して送る予定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵送先のみの変更可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is about the information notices I receive each month. It would be for just one month; I am not planning to have a card or anything similar reissued and sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether only the mailing address can be changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。対象と希望期間をメモして、担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I will note the items concerned and your requested period and give this to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 登録住所を全部変えるのではなく、案内の郵送先を一時的に変えられるか相談するんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 登録住所全体の変更ではなく、案内の郵送先だけを一時的に変更できるか相談するのだと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I am asking whether the mailing address for the notices can be changed temporarily, rather than changing my entire registered address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you are asking whether only the mailing address for the notices can be changed temporarily, rather than changing your entire registered address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。できるかどうかと、期間を設定できるかは確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will explain after checking whether this is possible and whether a period can be set.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、元の住所、姉の住所、滞在期間をメモします。今は住所変更として提出せず、担当の説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 可能な手続きの確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will note my original address, my sister's address, and my stay dates. For now I will not submit this as an address change, and will wait for the person in charge to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for confirmation of the available procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ご希望をそのように記録し、確認の担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will record your request that way and refer it to the staff member responsible for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の表示についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the product labeling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。元の文字の上に日本語のシールがあります。隠れた部分をはがして読んでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上貼りシールをはがして表示を読めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is a Japanese sticker over the original writing. May I peel it off to read the hidden part?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can peel off the overlaid sticker to read the label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 売場の商品をはがす前に、確認したい点を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before peeling anything off a product on the shelf, please tell me what you would like to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 原材料です。下の外国語を少し読めますが、日本語の欄と同じか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確認したい原材料と二言語の不明点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The ingredients. I can read a little of the foreign language underneath, but I don't know whether it says the same as the Japanese section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which ingredients you want to check and what is unclear between the two languages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示の資料があるか、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the person in charge whether we have labeling information available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外国語を読めるという理由だけで、隠れた内容まで理解したとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一部読めても隠れた全体を理解したとは言えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So being able to read the foreign language alone doesn't mean I can say I have understood the hidden content too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that reading part of it does not establish understanding of all the hidden content. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。見えない部分を推測せず、確認できる情報を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Please use information that can be verified, without guessing what is in the unseen section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原材料の全体を確認できる資料か、製造元などへの問い合わせ先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全体表示の資料または問い合わせ先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like information showing the full ingredient list, or contact details for the manufacturer or another appropriate party.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for full labeling information or a contact point for inquiries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当へ伝えます。商品はシールをはがさずお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge your request. Please bring the product without peeling the sticker off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は購入を決めず、この状態で確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: シールを保ったまま購入前の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not decide on buying it yet; please check it in this condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the sticker intact and ask for a check before purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示の確認に使える資料を探してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will look for information that can be used to check the labeling and let you know.
